guide.absmod.page.1:
Welcome!

Craft this guide with a book + raw cod. Use it in air to read. Use it on cats to observe. Open vanilla Advancements for your next goal.
guide.absmod.page.2:
First blades

Normal: diamond sword + 4 separate amethyst shards + raw cod + pink dye.
Dark: netherite sword + 4 separate crying obsidian + purple dye.
guide.absmod.page.3:
Resonance

Craft a heart with 4 amethyst shards, gold ingot and pink dye. Use it. Place the blade left and materials right. Hover over required materials to see what is missing. Check affection, then select Resonate. Reopen for another stage.
guide.absmod.page.4:
Normal 2-4

2: affection 10; 8 shards, 8 copper.
3: affection 25; 2 diamonds, 16 lapis.
4: affection 45; 4 amethyst blocks, 4 ender pearls.
guide.absmod.page.5:
Normal 5-6

5: affection 70; 4 diamonds, 4 blaze rods.
6: affection 100; 2 ghast tears, 4 phantom membranes, 8 amethyst blocks.
guide.absmod.page.6:
Normal 7-9

7: affection 140; 16 chorus fruit, 2 shulker shells, 4 diamonds.
8: affection 190; nether star, heart of the sea.
9: NOT OPEN. The soul-bound boss trial is not implemented.
guide.absmod.page.7:
Dark 2-4

2: affection 5; 8 obsidian.
3: affection 12; 8 gold ingots, 2 blaze rods.
4: affection 22; 8 crying obsidian.
guide.absmod.page.8:
Dark 5-8

5: affection 35; 2 ghast tears.
6: affection 50; 2 netherite scraps.
7: affection 70; 8 blaze rods, 8 pearls.
8: affection 100; netherite ingot. This is the final dark stage.
guide.absmod.page.9:
Combat

Hold Attack. Hits build normal combos. The HUD shows stacks and fading. Dark attacks leave short violet arcs.

Heavy (G by default): the HUD shows preparation and cooldown. Keep aiming. A ring marks a hit. Switching weapons or opening a menu cancels preparation.
guide.absmod.page.10:
Spirit recovery

Sneak-use the sword to manifest. The spirit follows across dimensions when safe. Use the link in the air to locate it.

Sneak-use the spirit or attack with the link to recall. Rejoining checks interrupted handoffs. If blocked, free the original slot and rejoin.
guide.absmod.page.11:
Affection

Each game day: talk +1; raw-cod gift +2; active following +1 per 5 min (max 4); 10 distinct hostile hits +1 (max 4). Upgrade gates do not spend affection. Sitting online alone is not active following.
guide.absmod.page.12:
Repair and recovery

Broken blades stay. Repair with diamond (normal) or netherite (dark). Mending works. Use one blade per repair.

After a disconnect, rejoin. Inventory full? Reopen the Heart for remaining items.
guide.absmod.page.13:
Cat collecting

Find village cats and tame with raw fish. Use this guide on a cat to read its dilution genes and generation. Your existing cats keep their looks. Genes stay saved across reloads.
guide.absmod.page.14:
A hidden color

DD: dense color.
Dd: hidden dilution carrier.
dd: dilute.
Each parent passes one allele. Dd x Dd gives a 25% dilute chance per kitten, not a promise that every fourth kitten is dilute.
guide.absmod.page.15:
Plan a pairing

Sneak-use the guide on the first cat; use it on a second nearby cat to predict dilution. Tame both, let them stand and feed fish to breed. Observe the kitten for lineage and collection advancements.
guide.absmod.page.16:
Cat lineage

Each parent passes D/d, B/b and C/cs alleles. Parent UUIDs and generation are saved. New coat goals follow on the next four pages.

26.2 uses advancements and this guide; 1.21.1 also supports FTB Quests.

guide.absmod.page.17:
Chocolate and lilac

BB and Bb conceal chocolate; bb expresses it. Combine bb with dd for lilac.

Find carriers, breed and observe offspring. Chance is not a guarantee. Reloading never rerolls genes.
guide.absmod.page.18:
Colorpoint family

Only cscs expresses pale bodies and dark extremities.

Dense black: seal point
Dilute black: blue point
Chocolate: chocolate point
Dilute chocolate: lilac point

Coats do not change with temperature.
guide.absmod.page.19:
Breeding goals

Observe offspring with bb, bb dd, cscs and all three recessives.

Two Dd Bb Ccs carriers have a 1.56% triple-recessive chance. Matching homozygous parents breed true.

Cat goals never block blade progression.
guide.absmod.page.20:
Coat combinations

8 ordinary colors,8 patterns,4 white markings,4 eye types and colorpoint give2048 combinations. Pink adds256.

Old cats keep their appearance; future offspring use the new system. Coat is not breed.

guide.absmod.page.21:
Cat palette

Colors: black,blue,chocolate,lilac,cinnamon,fawn,red,cream.

Patterns: solid,mackerel,classic,spotted,ticked,marbled,rosette,patched.

White: none,socks,bib,bicolor.
Eyes: amber,green,blue,odd.
guide.absmod.page.22:
Mix and inherit

The three loci still inherit normally. Color family,pattern,white and eyes each copy one parent, with a1/32 chance to reroll that feature.

This is cosmetic gameplay, not sex-linked orange biology. Sneak-use the guide to select a parent,then observe its partner.
guide.absmod.page.23:
Rare blush cats

Pale axolotl-inspired pink is a fantasy mutation.

Two ordinary parents:1/16384 per kitten. Dye cannot create it and reloading never rerolls it.

Observe a pink offspring for its optional goal; it never blocks blade progression.
guide.absmod.page.24:
Breeding rare pink

One pink parent:1/1024.
Two pink parents:1/128.

Pink never breeds true; nonpink cats have no hidden pink allele. Pink still combines with markings and odd eyes.

Prototype game odds,not real genetics.

guide.absmod.page.25:
Cat Collection

Use the guide on a cat to record it. Sneak and use the guide in the air to open the collection. Combine coat, pattern, and eye filters, or show only your cats.
guide.absmod.page.26:
Family Tree

Select a cat in the collection to see its parents and recorded kittens. Unseen relatives are marked as unobserved. Select a recorded relative to follow its family.
guide.absmod.page.27:
Moonfelt Cat Nest

Craft with 3 white wool, 3 planks and 2 string. Use the bell on your cat, then on the nest to assign it. Use an empty hand to send it home. Sneak-use to unbind.
guide.absmod.page.28:
Bond Bell

Craft with 4 copper ingots, amethyst, pink dye, and string. Use in the air to see companions. Sneak-use to call your cat within 16 blocks. Select a nearby spirit to recall its blade.

Spirit Adornments

Combine a gold nugget and string with one material from pages 32–33. Carry the adornment and select your nearby spirit using the Bond Bell. Choose Adornments to try on all 12 styles.

Companion Games

Use the Bell and select your nearby spirit, then Companion Games. Connect three marks in tic-tac-toe or five stones in Gomoku. Horizontal, vertical and diagonal lines count. Finish a round for its quest.
guide.absmod.page.35:
Reversi

Play black (●) first. Pick a dotted square to trap and flip white discs in a straight line. Passes are automatic. When neither side can move, the side with more discs wins.
